custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English Wizard.question: ১) He studied hard in order to pass the exam. (Make it complex)
English Wizard.option1: Though he studied hard, he pass the exam.
English Wizard.option2: He studies hard so that he pass the exam.
English Wizard.option3: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
English Wizard.option4: He studied hard so and  he passed the exam.
English Wizard.exp:
• The correct sentence is: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
----------------
• Simple Sentence এ 'in order to' থাকলে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- In order to এর স্থলে In order that অথবা So that বসবে। 
- এরপর noun phrase + can/could বসবে। 
- Present tense এর ক্ষেত্রে may এবং Past tense এর ক্ষেত্রে might বসে। 

Simple: We earn money in order to live a happy life. 
Complex: We earn money so that we may live a happy life. 

Simple: He studied hard in order to pass the exam. 
Complex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam. 

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

English Wizard.question: ২) Having finished her chores, she went for a walk. (Make it compound)
English Wizard.option1: If she had finished her chores, she would have gone for a walk.
English Wizard.option2: She had finished her chores and went for a walk.
English Wizard.option3: She had finished her chores so that went for a walk.
English Wizard.option4: She had finished her chores and so she went for a walk.
English Wizard.exp:
Perfect Participle যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Compound sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
Subject + Perfect Participle এর  Past Perfect form + and + বাকি অংশ বসে। 

Simple Sentence: Having finished her chores, she went for a walk.
Compound Sentence: She had finished her chores and went for a walk.

More Example:
Simple Sentence: Having forgotten him, I went out.
Compound Sentence: I had forgotten him and went out.

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ৩) What is the meaning of the phrase "as a last resort"?
English Wizard.option1: The preferred course of action.
English Wizard.option2: An alternative method.
English Wizard.option3: A final option after all others have failed.
English Wizard.option4: The initial step in problem-solving.
English Wizard.exp:
As a last resort (idiom): 
English Meaning - If all other methods fail. 
Bangla Meaning - শেষ অবলম্বন।

Example Sentences: 
- British police are supposed to use guns only as a last resort.
- As a last resort, the stranded hikers decided to signal for help by lighting a fire.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

English Wizard.question: ৪) Move and die. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: Move unless you die.
English Wizard.option2: If you move, you will die.
English Wizard.option3: Without moving you will die.
English Wizard.option4: If you do not move, you will die.
English Wizard.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: By moving you will die.
অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর না থাকায় প্রশ্নটি বাতিল করা হলো। 
=====================  

• The simple transformation of the sentence "Move and die." is: By moving you will die. 
-------------------
একটি simple sentence এ শুধু মাত্র একটি clause থাকে অর্থাৎ একটি subject and একটি finite verb থাকে।
-and যুক্ত compound sentence কে by/without + verb +ing এই নিয়মে simple sentence এ পরিণত করা যায়। 

প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্য, Move and die দ্বারা মূলত নড়লেই মারা পরবে এমন টা বুঝানো হয়েছে।

তাই সঠিক simple sentence হবে - By moving you will die.

তবে, Without moving you will die. এই বাক্যটি সঠিক হবেনা কারণ তখন বাক্যের মূল অর্থ পরিবর্তন হয়ে যায়।

English Wizard.question: ৫) By working hard, you will shine in life. (Make it complex)
English Wizard.option1: Working hard, you will shine in life.
English Wizard.option2: If you work hard, you will shine in life.
English Wizard.option3: You work hard so that you will shine in life.
English Wizard.option4: You work hard to shine in life.
English Wizard.exp:
• By/ In case of যুক্ত simple sentence টি যদি Modal auxiliary যোগে গঠিত হয়, তবে তা complex sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
-  By/in case of এর পরিবর্তে  If বসে + 
- Subject বসে +
- Verb বসে + 
- Adjective /Noun বসে + 
- Comma বসে + 
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে
- আর মূল Clause টি Future/ Present হলে If যুক্ত Clause টি Present Tense হয়।

Simple: By working hard, you will shine in life.
Complex: If you work hard, you will shine in life.

English Wizard.question: ৬) Though he was a rich man, he led a simple life. (Make it compound)
English Wizard.option1: He was a rich man and led a simple life.
English Wizard.option2: As he was rich, he led a simple life.
English Wizard.option3: Being rich he led a simple life.
English Wizard.option4: He was a rich man yet he led a simple life.
English Wizard.exp:
• Though/Although যুক্ত complex sentence কে compound sentence- এ পরিবর্তন করার নিয়ম: 
- দুটি sentence এর মাঝে but/yet coordinate marker ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
- অর্থাৎ দুইটা sentence- এর অর্থ যদি পরস্পর বিপরীত হয় তাহলে but/yet দ্বারা compound sentence করতে হয়।

Examples: 
Complex: Though he is poor, he is honest.
Compound: He is poor but honest.

Complex: Though he was a rich man, he led a simple life.
Compound: He was a rich man yet he led a simple life.

English Wizard.question: ৭) Which of the following options best defines the expression "to be a disaster"?
English Wizard.option1: To be moderately successful.
English Wizard.option2: To be highly unpredictable.
English Wizard.option3: To be very unsuccessful or extremely bad.
English Wizard.option4: To be exceptionally well-planned.
English Wizard.exp:
Be a disaster (phrase):
English Meaning - To be very unsuccessful or extremely bad. 
Bangla meaning -  মহাভারত অশুদ্ধ হওয়া। 

Example Sentences: 
- The evening was a complete disaster.
- Our first gig was a total disaster.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

English Wizard.question: ৮) Choose the appropriate complex sentence: 'The stolen watch was found.'
English Wizard.option1: The watch which was stolen is being found.
English Wizard.option2: The watch which is stolen was found.
English Wizard.option3: The watch which was stolen was found.
English Wizard.option4: The watch which was stolen has been found.
English Wizard.exp:
• Subject এর পরের verb টি past participle হলে Simple sentence কে Complex করার নিয়ম:
- Subject বসে।
- relative pronoun (who, which, that) বসে।
- tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- প্রদত্ত past participle থেকে sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

Simple: The stolen watch was found.
Complex: The watch which was stolen was found.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ৯) He has money and he can buy a car. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: Because of his having money, he can buy a car.
English Wizard.option2: He having money, he can buy a car.
English Wizard.option3: He has money, he can buy a car.
English Wizard.option4: Having money, he can buy a car.
English Wizard.exp:
And যুক্ত Compound Sentence এর উভয় অংশের Subject যদি একই হয় এবং প্রথম sentence দ্বারা কারণ বুঝায়, 
তাহলে Simple Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- প্রথমে Because of বসে + 
- প্রথম Sentence এর subject এর possessive form বসে + 
- be verb এর পরিবুরতে being বা have verb এর পরিবর্তে having বা মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ করতে হয় + 
- প্রথম sentence এর বাকী অংশ বসে + 
- and এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে + 
- দ্বিতীয় Sentence টি বসে। 

Compound: He has money and he can buy a car.
Simple: Because of his having money, he can buy a car. 

Source: Advanced Learner's English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ১০) Which of the following interpretations best describes the expression "below the belt"?
English Wizard.option1: In accordance with established regulations.
English Wizard.option2: Maintaining a high moral standard.
English Wizard.option3: In close proximity to the ground.
English Wizard.option4: Disregarding the rules or acting unfairly.
English Wizard.exp:
• Below the belt (idiom): 
English Meaning: disregarding the rules / unfair. 
Bangla Meaning: অন্যায়ভাবে

Ex. Sentence: Do you think it's a bit below the belt what they're doing?
Bangla Meaning: তোমার কি মনে হয় যে তারা যা করছে তা অন্যায়।

SourceL: Live MCQ lecture.

English Wizard.question: ১১) Choose the correct complex form of - ‘The man was poor and could not taste the food.’
English Wizard.option1: The man was poor so could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option2: Since the man poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option3: Since the man was poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.option4: The man was poor, he could not taste the food.
English Wizard.exp:
And যুক্ত Compound Sentence এর একটি clause যদি অন্যটির কারণ বা সময় নির্দেশ করে তবে তাকে Complex করার নিয়ম: 
- Sentence এর প্রথমে since/as/when বসে +
- প্রথম Sentence বসে +
- and এর পরিবর্তে comma(,) বসে +
- দ্বিতীয় sentence বসে। 

Structure: Since/As/When + প্রথম Sentence + and এর পরিবর্তে comma(,) + দ্বিতীয় sentence.

Compound: The man was poor and could not taste the food.
Complex: Since the man was poor, he could not taste the food.

Source:  Advanced Learner’s English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ১২) The meaning of the idiom 'Brown study' is -
English Wizard.option1: Expert in various subjects.
English Wizard.option2: Not paying attention to anything.
English Wizard.option3: Studying in a sophisticated place.
English Wizard.option4: Paying great attention to study.
English Wizard.exp:
Brown study (idiom): 
English Meaning: absorbed in one's thoughts and not paying attention to anything else.
Bangla Meaning: তীব্র নিমগ্নতা বা বিমূর্ততা / আনমনাভাব।

Ex. Sentence: I could see she was in a brown study.
Bangla Meaning: আমি দেখতে পাচ্ছিলাম সে খুব আনমনা হয়ে আছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Work hard or you cannot prosper in life. (Do Simple)
English Wizard.option1: If you do not work hard, you cannot prosper in life.
English Wizard.option2: Working hard, you will prosper in life.
English Wizard.option3: Though working hard, you will not prosper in life.
English Wizard.option4: Without working hard, you will not prosper in life.
English Wizard.exp:
Or যুক্ত Compound Sentence কে Simple করার নিয়ম: 
- প্রথমে Without বসে +
- প্রথম বাক্যের মূল verb এর সাথে ing যোগ হয় +
- ক্রিয়ার পরের অংশ বসে +
- or এর পরিবর্তে (,) বসে +
- দ্বিতীয় বাক্য বসে।

Structure: Without + verb + ing + Subject + extension.

Compound: Work hard or you cannot prosper in life.
Simple: Without working hard, you will not prosper in life. 

Source:  Advanced Learner’s English Grammar & Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He went out and I woke up. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: After his going out, I woke up.
English Wizard.option2: At the time of his going out, I woke up.
English Wizard.option3: After he had gone out, I woke up.
English Wizard.option4: I woke up by his going out.
English Wizard.exp:
• Compound to Simple: 
- And দিয়ে সাধারণত কারণ-ফলাফল, শর্ত-ফলাফল, সময়ের পর্যায়ক্রম অনুযায়ী ১ম কাজ - ২য় কাজ অথবা (প্রথম Clause টি Continuous Tense হলে) একটি কাজ সংঘটিত হওয়ার সময়ে আরেকটি কাজ সংঘটিত হওয়া ‍বুঝায়। 
- এক্ষেত্রে Preposition হিসেবে after ব্যবহৃত হবে। 
- ১ম ও ২য় Clause এর subject ভিন্ন ভিন্ন হলে ‍after এর পর Subject এর Possessive Form বসবে।
– এর পর verb+ing বসবে। 

Compound: He went out and I woke up.
Simple: After his going out, I woke up.

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Not many people can commit such heinous crimes in ________.
English Wizard.option1: close-fisted
English Wizard.option2: cold weather
English Wizard.option3: cold war
English Wizard.option4: cold blood
English Wizard.exp:
• Cold blood (idiom):   
- English Meaning: without emotion or pity / deliberately cruel or callous.
- Bangla Meaning: নৃশংস ভাবে, খুব ঠান্ডা মাথায় কিছু করা।    

Ex. Sentence: Not many people can commit such heinous crimes in cold blood.
Bangla Meaning: খুব বেশি মানুষ ঠান্ডা মাথায় এমন জঘণ্য অপরাধ করতে পারে না।

• Other options, 
- Cold War: A conflict over ideological differences carried on by methods short of sustained overt military action and usually without breaking off diplomatic relations.
- Close-fisted: Unwilling to spend money/means.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

English Wizard.question: ১৬) I saw him at the time of playing. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: I saw him when he played.
English Wizard.option2: I saw him when he was playing.
English Wizard.option3: I saw him on playing time.
English Wizard.option4: I saw him in playing time.
English Wizard.exp:
• যদি কোনো Simple Sentence এ at the time of থাকে, উক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তরের সময় -
- At the time of এর পরিবর্তে  when বসে।

Simple: I saw him at the time of playing.
Complex: I saw him when he was playing.
- এ বাক্যে প্রথম clause টি অপরিবর্তিত রয়েছে।
- তারপর At the time of এর পরিবর্তে  when বসেছে।
- এরপর প্রথম clause টির tense এর form অনুযায়ী 
- পরবর্তী Clause টি he was playing লিখা হয়েছে।

• এ জাতীয় আরোও একটি উদাহরণ হচ্ছে -
- They heard her at  the time of singing.
- They heard her when she was singing.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ১৭) The weather being cold, we cannot go out. (Make it Compound)
English Wizard.option1: As The weather is cold and we cannot go out.
English Wizard.option2: As The weather is cold we cannot go out.
English Wizard.option3: The weather is cold and we cannot go out.
English Wizard.option4: The weather is cold yet we go out.
English Wizard.exp:
• Being যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Compound Sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম: 
- Being এর বাকি অংশোটি যে tense এ আছে Being- কেও সেই একই tense গঠন করতে হবে। 
- Sentence দুটির মাঝে 'and' বসে। 

Simple: The weather being cold, we cannot go out. 
Compound: The weather is cold and we cannot go out.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Wizard.question: ১৮) Which of the following idioms represents the meaning 'Laugh uncontrollably'?
English Wizard.option1: Fall about
English Wizard.option2: Fall flat
English Wizard.option3: Fall off
English Wizard.option4: Fall on hard times
English Wizard.exp:
Fall about: 
English Meaning: laugh uncontrollably / to laugh without being able to stop.
Bangla Meaning: হাসিতে ভেঙ্গে পড়া।

Ex. Sentence: We fell about when we heard her reply.
Bangla Meaning: তার উত্তর শুনে আমরা হাসিতে ভেঙ্গে পড়লাম।

Other options,
Fall flat - fail completely to produce the intended or expected effect.
Fall off - 1. decrease in number, amount, intensity, or quality.
2. become detached and drop to the ground.
Fall on hard times - to lose your money and start to have a difficult life.

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

English Wizard.question: ১৯) They knew him to be a thief. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: They knew at the time he was a thief.
English Wizard.option2: He was a known thief.
English Wizard.option3: He was known to be a thief.
English Wizard.option4: They knew that he was a thief.
English Wizard.exp:
• Sub + verb + object + to be + ........... যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- Sub + verb বসে +
- that বসে + 
- object এর subject রূপ বসে + 
- tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb + 
- adjective বসে। 

Simple: They knew him to be a thief.
Complex: They knew that he was a thief.

English Wizard.question: ২০) What does the phrase "hard up" mean?
English Wizard.option1: Being in a difficult situation financially.
English Wizard.option2: Having firm beliefs.
English Wizard.option3: Experiencing physical discomfort.
English Wizard.option4: Being in a state of confusion or uncertainty.
English Wizard.exp:
• Hard up (idiom): 
English Meaning: short of money / having very little money.
Bangla Meaning: দরিদ্র / অভাবগ্রস্থ / স্বচ্ছল নয়

Ex. Sentence: I'm too hard up to buy fancy clothes.
Bangla Meaning: দামি দামি জামা কাপড় কেনার মত টাকাপয়সা নেই আমার।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
